name: Nature Networks Fund
summary: Capital-focused grants of £250,000 to £1 million for habitat work on and around Wales' protected sites, run by the National Lottery Heritage Fund for the Welsh Government with Natural Resources Wales. Round six is closed to new expressions of interest.
reporting: Grantees submit an evaluation report before the last 10% of the grant is paid, and share monitoring data and geo-spatial data on where the project worked.

eligibility.rule: Delivering direct benefits to the protected site network now or in the future
Including Welsh language in all aspects of the work
Completing the project by 31 March 2030, including financial reporting and evaluation
Owning the freehold or holding a lease with at least five years left after completion for grant-funded property
Ensuring public benefit outweighs private gain and subsidy control rules are not breached on private land
Starting the project only after a decision is made
Excluding ongoing maintenance, land acquisition, large-scale buildings, recoverable VAT and pre-award activity costs
Submits no more than one application as lead applicant

administered_by.quote: We're delivering the Nature Networks Fund on behalf of the Welsh Government

geography.quote: The area you are improving must be in Wales, but you/your organisation can be based anywhere in the UK.

access.quote: You must first submit an Expression of Interest to tell us about your idea. You may then be invited to make a full application.

co_finance_required.quote: There are no requirements for cash or non-cash contributions for the Nature Networks Fund.

reporting.quote: At the end of your project, we will expect you to submit an evaluation report.

effort.quote: You must submit your Expression of Interest by the deadline of 12noon on 5 August 2026.
If your Expression of Interest is successful, you must submit your full application by 12noon on 3 November 2026.

eligibility.quote: Activities must deliver direct benefits to the protected site network now or in the future.
You must include the Welsh language in all aspects of your work.
You must complete your project by 31 March 2030, including all financial reporting and evaluation.
You must own the freehold or have a lease with at least five years left to run after the Project Completion Date.
Projects can deliver works or activities on private land so long as any public benefit clearly outweighs any potential private gain and provided subsidy control rules are not breached.
Your project must not start before we make a decision.

You may not include costs for: ongoing maintenance or running costs beyond the duration of the project acquisition of land or buildings construction of new, large scale buildings (eg: visitor centres) recoverable VAT costs for any activity that has taken place before a grant is awarded
Eligible organisations can submit a maximum of one application as the lead applicant to the Nature Networks Fund.

after_award.quote: At the end of your project, we will expect you to submit an evaluation report.
